item.title: San Diego Clippers standout Sean Pedulla named G League Rookie of the Year
item.description: San Diego Clippers guard Sean Pedulla has been named the NBA G League Rookie of the Year for the 2025-26 season, after averaging 23.6 points, 6.8 assists, five rebounds and 1.6 steals in 20 G League games.

item.title: Pair of wildfires prompts thousands to evacuate in Riverside, LA Counties
item.description: Thousands of people in Riverside and Los Angeles Counties are under evacuation due to two wildfires, the Spring's Fire and the Crown Fire, which have grown to 4,176 and 345 acres respectively and are being fueled by dry, gusty winds.
